## Task Launcher 0.2.1

The panel's sections are easier to scan, and you can report a bug or request a feature straight from the panel.

- Each section header now has an icon, a title and a one-line description of what it is for, with separators between sections.
- Each filter sits on one row with its label in front, so all dropdowns line up and the filter list is shorter.
- Display fields show as checkboxes in two columns, and board fields appear only when the project has a board.
- New bug and feature buttons in the panel's bottom right open the GitHub issue forms. The bug form arrives with the plugin version already filled in.
- With no GitHub repository selected, the panel now says so and asks you to pick a workspace that has one.

No new plugin capabilities. Updates install without re-approval.
